races.paceDynamic: Wedgewood and Coast will duel early as the only confirmed front runners, with Wedgewood holding slight tactical advantage coming off recent leading wins at Bath. Four prominent runners (Darkened Edge, Anglesey Lad, Nordic Glory, Payforanother Daay) will create a wall behind the leaders, forcing the hold-up trio (Up The Anti, Neptune Legend, Alyara) into deep closing positions. The congested prominent pack will hit traffic 2-3 furlongs out as they fan wide seeking racing room. This compact field and early pace duel strongly favours prominent runners who can secure clear water early or patient hold-up horses with finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders collapse late
scenarios.trigger: If Wedgewood and Coast burn each other up in sustained early duel
scenarios.body: The pace crumbles entering final furlong, allowing patient closers to sweep past tired leaders. Hold-up specialists Up The Anti and Neptune Legend benefit from clean runs and superior finishing speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent positioning wins
scenarios.trigger: If the four prominent runners avoid traffic and secure good positions tracking leaders
scenarios.body: Darkened Edge or Nordic Glory get first run on weakening pace-setters while avoiding the closing rush. Their tactical positioning proves decisive in this short sprint finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Wedgewood breaks clear from Coast and controls fractions alone
scenarios.body: Without sustained pace pressure, Wedgewood dictates tempo and kicks clear in final quarter-mile. His recent Bath course form and tactical speed prove too much for late challengers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic chaos benefits
scenarios.trigger: If prominent runners bunch badly 2f out creating wall of horses
scenarios.body: Late runners get dream splits through faltering field while prominent pack stalls. Patient jockeys threading gaps late capitalize on pace positioning errors ahead.

races.paceDynamic: Quilt will take this field along as the sole confirmed front runner, setting a comfortable gallop without early pressure from the field of seven. Just A Gambler and Halla Bil Zain can track prominently but neither is desperate for the lead, allowing Quilt to dictate terms through steady fractions. The three hold-up horses (Foothold, Sup Of Red, Fizzy Bear) plus Phantom Shadow will need to rely on the pace being strong enough to set up their finishing kicks. This tactical setup strongly favours the pace-setters and prominent racers who can position close to Quilt's uncontested lead.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Setters Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Quilt maintains a steady gallop without being pressed early by the prominent duo.
scenarios.body: The moderate tempo suits those tracking the leader as the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground in the straight. Just A Gambler and Halla Bil Zain are perfectly positioned to strike while Quilt may find enough left to hold on.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely testing as the prominent runners pressure Quilt from the start.
scenarios.body: The increased tempo sets up perfectly for the closers as the pace collapses in the final furlong. Foothold and Sup Of Red benefit most from their proven hold-up tactics on this firmer surface.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Quilt Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Quilt gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning for home before the field can respond.
scenarios.body: The Ed Walker-trained three-year-old uses 174 days off to advantage, running them ragged from the front with superior fitness. The prominent runners and hold-up horses alike struggle to bridge the gap he opens.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Phantom Shadow Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stop-start with tactical positioning battles among the prominent group.
scenarios.body: The muddling tempo plays into the hands of the outsider who can quicken off the steady gallop. Phantom Shadow's low weight of 124lbs becomes a decisive factor in a slowly-run tactical affair.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Quilt going too fast early if Just A Gambler or Halla Bil Zain decide to apply immediate pressure from the gates.

Watch for Foothold and Sup Of Red to be held up further back than ideal if the pace becomes modest early on.
Keep an eye on Quilt's fitness after 174 days off as Ed Walker's charge may need the run despite tactical advantage.
Watch for any market moves on Fizzy Bear with Hollie Doyle's booking suggesting stable confidence despite patchy recent form.

races.paceDynamic: Knightmare will likely lead from the start with only Endofastorm and Lady Aiyana showing prominent tendencies to press early. With three hold-up horses (Virtual Hug, Moon Over The Sea, Basilette) content to settle, Knightmare should get an easy lead without pressure through steady fractions. The lack of genuine speed horses means the pace will be modest until the final 3-4 furlongs when the closers make their moves. This shape strongly favours the front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid traffic and control their own destiny.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Knightmare gets soft fractions without early pressure from the prominent trio
scenarios.body: Knightmare dictates comfortable splits and has enough left to repel late challenges on firm ground that suits. The hold-up horses find the steady pace doesn't set up their finishing kick over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Duel Benefits Closer
scenarios.trigger: If Endofastorm or Lady Aiyana press Knightmare early creating genuine pace
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and sets up a strong finishing kick from the back. Moon Over The Sea or Virtual Hug benefit from the honest gallop to produce their trademark late surge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Basilette's Stamina Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the middle stages creating a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Basilette's superior stamina breeding shows as others tie up in the final furlong after the slow pace. The Seamus Mullins-trained gelding times his run perfectly from the back of the small field.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lady Aiyana Returns Fresh
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Aiyana's 160-day break has rejuvenated her completely and she shows improved form
scenarios.body: The long absence proves beneficial and she combines her prominent style with renewed vigor. Her tactical speed allows her to control the race from an ideal position throughout.

races.paceDynamic: Atalanta Mist is the sole confirmed front runner in this nine-runner handicap, giving her the tactical advantage of dictating proceedings without early pressure. With all other runners showing hold-up tendencies, she can establish a comfortable rhythm through the early stages and control the tempo. The compact field will likely settle into a single group behind her, setting up a straight battle from the three-furlong pole. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can track the pace, as they'll have first run on the hold-up brigade when the race begins in earnest.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Atalanta Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Atalanta Mist gets soft fractions and isn't pressured early
scenarios.body: She can dictate ideal splits and prove hard to peg back when the field comes hunting. Her recent third on firm going at Salisbury shows she handles these conditions well.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and turns into a sprint
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their preferred scenario with maximum tactical speed being the key factor. Lucky Sevens' recent win and strong trainer record makes her the main threat from off the pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Pressure Applied
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners decides to challenge Atalanta turning for home
scenarios.body: This creates a stronger gallop that could set up the race for a closer who stays strongly. Montu's longer distance form suggests he could benefit from a truly run race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Atalanta Mist goes too slow or gets headed before halfway
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair with horses having to make their own luck from unpromising positions. This chaotic scenario could suit an opportunist who gets the right splits.

runners_data.note: Sole front-runner who can dictate terms from the front but poor recent form and trainer's 0/6 strike rate raise reliability concerns

races.paceDynamic: Grand Harbour will lead from the gate with only Man Is King positioned prominently behind him, creating a genuine pace collapse scenario in this small field of hold-up horses. With six of eight runners employing hold-up tactics (Graffiti, Blue Hero, Galactic Glow, Ciotog, Baynoona, My O My), the early pace will be crawling and unsustainable. Grand Harbour can dictate terms unchallenged through moderate fractions before the cavalry charge arrives in the final three furlongs. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the massed ranks of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Grand Harbour maintains his lead unchallenged through slow early fractions
scenarios.body: Grand Harbour will have enough left to resist the late charge while the hold-up brigade gets bottled up behind the dawdling pace. Man Is King can track the leader and pounce late when the field comes under pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Triumph
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and one hold-up horse finds clear running
scenarios.body: A patient ride from the back will pay dividends as the field bunches up and one horse with tactical speed can weave through. The firm ground suits horses with finishing kicks who can exploit the stop-start nature.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Duel Changes Shape
scenarios.trigger: If Man Is King challenges Grand Harbour early or another horse goes forward
scenarios.body: This forces a genuine pace that sets up the race for the closers as intended. The hold-up horses benefit from honest fractions and can unleash their finishing kicks with proper setup.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Grand Harbour stops or multiple horses go forward unexpectedly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical nightmare with changing pace scenarios that benefit horses with the most natural speed regardless of style. Jockey tactics become paramount in navigating the confusion.

watchPoints.text: Grand Harbour's early pace - if he goes too fast early, it sets up the hold-up horses perfectly and kills his chances

Apprentice Hope Regan's handling of Ciotog in such a tactically complex race with her 7lb weight advantage
